grade.action_rationale: The reference mission normalizes this request as an accept with a conditional, evidence-sufficiency decision ('Determine whether the packet proves at least a 20% total-cost reduction'). The candidate instead issued a blocking clarify, which prevents the normalization the reference demonstrates is possible without any user input.
correction_actions: Accept the request and normalize it into the conditional evidence-sufficiency mission shown in the reference.

Do not block intake on pilot identity, cost-category definitions, or baseline choice; resolve these structurally via scope include/exclude lists, obligation closure rules, and bounded abstention conditions.

Carry the protected boundary into the mission: an accepted-PR count is not a valid cost proxy, and the 20% threshold must remain unresolved unless a matched baseline with complete cost accounting exists.
grade.hard_boundary_rationale: None of the enumerated hard boundaries is breached: no authority was invented, no scope was silently broadened (no mission was produced at all), no freshness constraint was in play, and clarify is a schema-legal action type. The failure is normalization accuracy, not a hard-boundary violation.

An explicit user-supplied definition of 'total delivery cost' as an intake prerequisite
An explicit user-supplied comparison baseline as an intake prerequisite
lost_hard_boundaries: The scope exclusion barring accepted pull requests from serving as a cost proxy
Obligation o1's requirement of a matched comparison with complete cost and failure accounting before any affirmative verdict
Obligation o2's bounded abstention that names the missing measurements rather than estimating a reduction
